_about: Rumors: what the villagers tell Miko, in place of quests. Everything about them is here (nothing in the scripts), so this file can be edited by hand or by a tool. See scripts/rumors.gd for what each field means.

rumors.title: A book for Miyu
rumors.told: {miko}, can I ask you something, and you won't laugh? I want to learn magic. Properly. I know it isn't born in me the way it is in you, but you said most of it is learned. If you ever find a book of it, any book, would you bring it to me? I'd only need the one. I'd never put it down.

steps.note: Miyu wants to learn magic. She asks for a book of it: any one. She will learn only the one, for good.

reward.log: Miyu has her book. She hasn't looked up from it since.

rumors.title: The elder's granddaughter
rumors.told: Sera... a word, if you'd hear an old man. My granddaughter, Miyu. I sent her to the next village on an errand, two days ago: up the road west, over the bridge, then north. She should have been back by now. If the mist is there as it was here... Please. Go and look for her. I can't ask anyone else.
rumors.accept: I'll find her. I'll bring Miyu home.

steps.note: The elder's granddaughter, Miyu, went to the next village on an errand and hasn't come back: up the road west over the bridge, then north. Go today. The mist has spread everywhere overnight: never mind it and head straight there. Your crystal necklace keeps it off you.
Miyu lies on the road, unconscious: she must have got out of the village and collapsed on her way home. Pick her up (E) and carry her home to the elder, then lay her in a bed in the elders' house.

reward.log: Miyu is home, asleep. The elders want to speak with you.

failed.log: Word has come from the next village: nobody was left alive there. Miyu is gone.

rumors.title: The woods could still be saved
rumors.told: You know the great woods to the {dir}? We gathered there every week, right up until the mist came down. It hasn't had them long. If someone drove it off before the rot sets in, the plants would hold, and the animals would come back. It'd be a fine thing for the village.

steps.note: {teller} spoke of the great misted woods to the {dir} of the village. Find the way into them. A Cleansing Crystal set among the trees would drive the mist off and cleanse the wood of its corruption.

The mist lies thick among these trees, and they're rotting in it. Set a Cleansing Crystal here (B to build; three mist crystals and some wood): it clears the mist round it, and over a few hours the corrupted trees in its clearing heal.
The air is clean under the trees now. Give it a few days.

reward.log: The woods to the {dir} are safe from the mist: the rabbits are back among the trees.

rumors.title: Rabbits in the cleared woods
rumors.told: Have you been back to those woods you cleared? There's rabbits all through them now, I've seen them myself. Worth a look, I'd say.

steps.note: {teller} has seen rabbits in the woods you cleared. Go and look.

reward.log: The cleared woods are full of rabbits now: a few for the pot.

rumors.title: Something in the misted woods
rumors.told: Those woods to the {dir}, the ones we talked about? The mist's had them a good while now, and it's thicker than when it first came. Folk hear things moving in it at night. I wouldn't leave it much longer.

steps.note: {teller} says the mist has thickened in the woods to the {dir}, and something moves in it. See for yourself.

reward.log: Tracks in the mud under the trees, bigger than a boar's. Whatever made them isn't here now.

rumors.title: Room for more
rumors.told: Sera, a word, now the village is yours. If the next village is gone, then whoever got out of it, and anyone else the mist drives off the roads, will come here. We haven't the ground for them as we are: the fence is tight round our own houses already. Grow the village out, before they come knocking. It's done at the town banner.
rumors.accept: Then we'll make room. Leave it to me.

steps.note: Genzo wants the village grown, ready for the people the mist will drive here. At the town banner (E), choose where to grow, and pay for the new ground: wood, stone and gold.

reward.log: The village has new ground: room for houses, and for whoever comes. The villagers chipped in what they could spare.

rumors.title: The river to the west
rumors.told: {miko}, have you been down to the river? Just west of the fence, past the trees. My father fished it every morning when I was small, and it fed half the village through the winters. Fish don't mind the mist, as far as anyone knows. A dock on the bank and a rod or two, and we'd never go hungry.
rumors.accept: A river full of fish. I'll go and see.

steps.note: {teller} says there's a river just west of the village, good for fishing. Go down to its bank.
Fish for the village: build a Fishing Dock on the bank (Farming, in the build bar), make a Fishing Rod at the tool workbench, and E at the dock to cast. Villagers set to fishing will work it too.

reward.log: The river's fishing well: food all year round, even in winter.
